summary: Managed Gmail search rows carry hasAttachments, and an explicit in:trash query lists Trash.

contract.hasAttachments: boolean on every normalized message: true for a multipart/mixed container (the only signal format=metadata returns) or any named part (format=full); documented as a paperclip hint, not an attachment inventory; older servers omit it
contract.trash: users.messages.list sets includeSpamTrash=true only when the query contains an explicit in:trash token; every other query keeps includeSpamTrash=false
contract.capabilities: inbox-v1 capabilities.searchTrash = read scope; older servers omit it and clients do not offer a Trash folder
